## Activity

During July 2023, North City Eye Clinic recorded 454 captures. This provides the activity total for the reporting period and reflects the volume submitted through the clinic’s imaging service. The result is recorded for routine operational monitoring and provides a basis for reviewing image quality and grading performance.

## Image quality

Of the 454 captures, 7 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 1.5. These cases could not proceed to grading and are included in the quality review for the month. No new equipment faults were raised by staff during the reporting period.

## Grading

A total of 110 results were recorded as referable. The median grading lag was 2. This measure records the typical interval associated with grading activity during July 2023. Overall, the activity, image quality and grading figures provide the monthly operational position for North City Eye Clinic.
